$comment: Pinned commits so a benchmark run measures TestPilot changes, not upstream churn. Bump deliberately, in a PR that explains the diff. Sparse patterns are non-cone (gitignore-style); the root package.json matters — without it project-root discovery escapes the checkout.

repos.name: cal.com
repos.note: projects[] with RegExp testMatch; the most test-id-driven suite in the corpus.

repos.name: immich
repos.note: Playwright config lives in e2e/, RegExp testMatch, *.e2e-spec.ts naming.

repos.name: Ghost
repos.note: Page objects hold the locators; most real findings live outside the spec files.

repos.name: documenso
repos.note: High getByRole adoption — the control for 'does the score reward good practice'. Run from the package that owns the suite, as its own contributors would — its Playwright config is two levels down, past the one-level lookup.

repos.name: mattermost
repos.note: Largest suite; the runtime and false-positive volume check. Run from the package that owns the suite, as its own contributors would — its Playwright config is two levels down, past the one-level lookup.
